dialog.um2.heavy_workbench: A slightly more advanced workbench is required to work with magical materials. All other recipes in this book use the Heavy Workbench instead of a regular crafting table.
dialog.um2.demonomicon.1: This ancient tome describes all sorts of forbidden and forgotten arcana. Once viewed, the contents are not easily forgotten; one can read the tome without possessing it using the command
dialog.um2.demonic_steel_longsword: Using Demonic Steel, a unique blade can be made. Trading attack speed for increased damage and reach, it also rewards aggression: six consecutive hits on an enemy within a few seconds will grant a small amount of absorption health.
dialog.um2.demonic_reinforced_bow: Using Demonic Steel, a powerful compound bow can be made. While normally similar to a regular bow, if the arrow is fired with precise timing just after it is fully charged, it will be fired as a "perfect shot" with much higher damage and piercing capabilities.
dialog.um2.demonic_steel_armor: Demonic Steel can be used to forge an armor set that takes inspiration from the demons from whence it came. While its armor rating is only a slight improvement over iron armor, it rewards aggression with vitality; six consecutive hits on an enemy within a few seconds will grant absorption health, with the amount and duration increasing for each piece worn (and stacking with the longsword).
dialog.um2.dragon_drops.title: Ender Dragon's Drops
dialog.um2.dragon_drops.1: The Ender Dragon, the fearsome beast tied to the bounds between dimensions, will randomly yield one of two powerful weapons when defeated.
dialog.um2.dragon_drops.2: The Dragon Lash is a flail-type weapon that can be charged to launch a draconic projectile. It bursts into acid on impact, and its damage is based on your melee damage.
dialog.um2.dragon_drops.3: The Dragon's Wrath is a longbow harnessing the dragon's vitriol. Normal shots fly with higher velocity and burst into acid on impact, but it can be charged past the regular maximum to fire a mid-ranged shockwave of dragon's breath.
dialog.um2.demonic_steel.title: Demonic Steel
dialog.um2.demonic_steel: Demonic Steel is an alloy formed from iron and demonic viscera, possessing a connection with the qualities that demons embody: unrelenting aggression and the flames of the Nether. This alloy can be used to craft unique equipment.
dialog.um2.nether_shard:
The Nether Star, a radiant relic formed from the corpse of the Wither, seems to have applications in the creation of items of extraordinary power.
However, many of these applications do not require the full power of the Star. Thus, the Star can be broken up into five Nether Shards for use in these smaller applications. It can also be reconstructed from five Shards as needed.
dialog.um2.demons.title: Demons
dialog.um2.demons:
An ancient warrior race suffused with the essences of the Nether. They have constructed Demonic Keeps scattered throughout the dimension, and hold a strict hierarchy based around combat prowess.

Slaying demons will yield Demon Skin, useful for certain recipes.
dialog.um2.maxon.1: The Nether's heritage is strongest in General Maxon, the militaristic lord of all demons. He, like the rest of his race, is presently sealed beyond the Nether Portal, but should one wish to challenge him and stop his designs on the conquest of the Overworld, one would be able to do so with a contract known as the General's Conscription.
dialog.um2.maxon.2:
Tips:

 - Maxon is a fearsome foe, stronger and far keener than the Ender Dragon or the Wither. Preparation is advised before challenging him; a flat area and various potions may be of use.

 - Maxon is highly aggressive and can quickly close any distance. Stay close to him to more easily avoid his thrusts.

 - The world difficulty affects not only Maxon's damage, but also the speed and patterns of his attacks. If you're having trouble avoiding damage, feel free to decrease it.

 - Shields are ineffective against Maxon, as he has mastered techniques allowing him to shatter them in only a few hits. Cowardice will be punished.

 - Rumor has it that Maxon's armor seals away the true power of his heritage...
dialog.um2.maxon.3: Defeating Maxon is the only way to claim his signature weapon, the polearm known as Flare Runner.
dialog.um2.empyrean_array.1: High in the Overworld's sky at the Temple of the Firmament, an ancient construct known as the Empyrean Array sleeps. This forgotten superweapon, constructed by a long-gone civilization, holds the power to manipulate storms. The Array controls multiple robotic bodies at once, which it uses to perform synchronized attacks.
dialog.um2.empyrean_array.2:
Tips:

 - While the Empyrean Array can be reached and fought at any time, it is much easier to access with Elytra and is intended to be fought after the Ender Dragon. Preparation is advised before challenging it.

 - The world difficulty affects not only the Array's damage, but also the speed and complexity of its attack patterns. If you're having trouble avoiding damage, feel free to decrease it.

 - Damaging one of the Array's robotic bodies enough will disrupt its attacks for a time; focusing your damage can greatly reduce the threat of some attack patterns.

 - The Array may be able to harness the power of a second, much more devastating energy source in addition to electricity...


Defeating the Empyrean Array will yield one of two weapon drops, depending on the time of day it is defeated at.
dialog.um2.empyrean_array.3: During the day, the crossbow Heap Driver will be dropped.
dialog.um2.empyrean_array.4: During the night, the polearm Fractured Halo will be dropped.
